Chapter 230: Chapter 19 'Update' Martial Path Evolutionary Path_2

Chapter 230: Chapter 19 ‘Update’ Martial Path Evolutionary Path_2

Father’s shoulders were wide, sturdy enough to bear the livelihood of their entire family.

“After so many years, father and mother have long been dead…”

Heiyu Mo’s thoughts returned to reality.

Though his father and mother had passed, the other clan members, whose names Heiyu Mo could no longer recall, were still his kin.

In Heiyu Mo’s heart, these members of the Heiyu family were nothing more than tools to disguise his true identity.

Ever since he had infiltrated human civilization, Heiyu Mo had not let his guard down for a moment.

...

“Father, mother, I will come to see you soon.”

Heiyu Mo stood up and walked over to the trembling Heiyu Ao, helped him up, and said, “Come, let’s go apologize to the Thirteenth Peak Master.”

…

Chikun Main Star.

In the square of the Central Continent.

Heiyu Mo, accompanied by Heiyu Ao, sought an audience with the Thirteenth Peak Master.

“Brother Heiyu Mo, your youngest son…” The steward of the Red Kun Lineage looked at Heiyu Mo with a trace of pity on his face.

Since the identity of the Thirteenth Peak Master was made public, every bit of information about Lin Yuan had been unearthed.

Among them was the issue of Heiyu Ao suppressing the Thirteenth Peak Master.

In others’ eyes, Heiyu Mo was just terribly unlucky, having had a good standing in the family, only to offend the Thirteenth Peak Master because of his youngest son.

How unfair was that?

In fact, Heiyu Ao was unlucky too.

For someone of his direct lineage in a prominent clan, using his power to suppress an Evolver without any background was not unusual.

The Human Civilization Alliance, governed by three goddesses from on high, rarely saw violations of the law.

Yet suppression was unavoidable.

Take for example, “This company is mine, and if I don’t like you, I can let the company fire you.”

Under the oversight of the three goddesses, at most the full penalty would be paid, and they wouldn’t insist on employing a particular person.

“Give a message to the Thirteenth Peak Master.”

“Just tell him that I, Heiyu Mo, have a valuable treasure to offer.”

Heiyu Mo said softly to the steward.

This was also to pique the Thirteenth Peak Master’s curiosity.

To entice him into showing up for a meeting.

Heiyu Mo, as a Seventh Rank Evolver, might be referring to a treasure of king-level ranking at the Seventh Rank.

Such treasures, even valued by the Great Peak Master, the Second, and the Third, would be taken seriously; Lin Yuan, having just become the Thirteenth Peak Master, might have risen in status, but certainly didn’t possess many treasures.

“Understood.”

The steward of the Red Kun Lineage nodded.

He saw nothing strange in this.

Moreover, coming over to seek forgiveness, one should not come empty-handed, right?

…

After watching the steward leave,

Heiyu Mo composed himself.

All he could do now was wait.

Wait for the Thirteenth Peak Master to summon him so he could activate that secret technique and strangle this human genius within the Sixth Rank.

In exchange for a better living environment and resources for his race.

…

Inside the palace on the peak.

Lin Yuan received the news that Heiyu Mo was bringing Heiyu Ao to seek forgiveness.

But—

Lin Yuan had no intention of meeting them.

Before his life imprint merged into the cosmos, Lin Yuan could hardly settle down to cultivate, let alone meet people.

And his eldest senior brother had made it very clear.

For Lin Yuan, the most important thing now was to integrate his life imprint into the cosmos.

As for everything else? Even meeting his teacher, the Chikun Starlord, could be postponed, let alone Heiyu Mo.

“It’s almost time.”

Lin Yuan breathed out lightly, his eyes shining.

Integrating the life imprint, though not difficult, and something any Sixth Rank Evolver could achieve, was a process that required patience and could not be rushed.

…

Canglan Star.

Continental Manor.

“Xiaoyuan’s seclusion is lasting quite long this time.”

Lu Qiong’s face showed a hint of worry.

“Isn’t that normal?”

Lin Shoucheng had grown accustomed.

“After all, my son is Canglan Star’s once-in-ten-millennia genius.”

“What’s a few months of seclusion? I’ve heard those Higher Rank Evolvers, every time they seclude themselves, it could be for dozens or even hundreds of years.”

Lin Shoucheng said.

“Right.”

“Daughter.”

Lin Shoucheng glanced at Lin Yi not far away.

At the moment, Lin Yi was watching the Thirteenth Peak Master’s combat videos over and over.

“Yes, yes, yes.”

Lin Yi responded nonchalantly.

Just then,

The smart housekeeper mentioned that someone had come to visit.

“Governor Song has come over?”

Lu Qiong immediately stood up, ready to greet the visitor personally.

Because of Lin Yuan’s championship in the arena competition, Song Wuyang often came over to pay his respects.

So, Song Wuyang’s visit did not attract much attention from the family.

Very soon,

Song Wuyang walked in.

“Governor Song, Xiaoyuan is currently in closed meditation and can’t come out for the time being. I’m sorry…”

Lu Qiong’s face was full of apologies.

She naturally knew that Song Wuyang’s visit could only mean he was looking for Lin Yuan; as for them, they didn’t have the status to warrant a personal visit from Governor Song.

“I’ll notify Xiaoyuan right away.”

Lin Shoucheng got up, intending to send a message to Lin Yuan.

Of course, such a notification was like leaving a ‘voicemail,’ which Lin Yuan would only see when he was done with his affairs.

“No need, no need.”

Song Wuyang hurriedly waved his hand, “Mr. Lin must be busy over at Chikun Main Star; I just came over to have a look. I wouldn’t dare disturb him.”

Upon hearing this, Lu Qiong and Lin Shoucheng,

looked slightly stunned.

What did Song Wuyang just say?

Xiaoyuan is on Chikun Main Star?

“Governor Song, you must be mistaken. My brother was still in meditation in the main building a few days ago,”

Lin Yi, noticing the ‘error’ in Song Wuyang’s words, couldn’t help but interject.

“Little Yi,”

Lu Qiong glared at Lin Yi.

Even if Song Wuyang was mistaken, it wasn’t appropriate to point it out directly.

That was too impolite.

“Hahaha, don’t worry about it, Governor Song. Little Yi is just like that. But still, you must pay attention to rest amidst your busy schedule…”

Lin Shoucheng seized the opportunity to say.

“Mr. Lin, Mrs. Lu, and… Miss Lin,”

Song Wuyang’s expression became solemn, “I’m not mistaken, Mr. Lin should indeed be on Chikun Main Star.”

Song Wuyang paused for a moment, then continued: “Also, there is some great news I need to share.”

“Your son, Mr. Lin Yuan, is the Thirteenth Peak Master of the Red Kun lineage.”

Song Wuyang declared.

As soon as these words came out,

Lin Shoucheng, Lu Qiong, and Lin Yi looked at Song Wuyang.

“It seems like Governor Song has indeed been overworking himself…” Lin Shoucheng stepped forward to smooth things over.

“However, Governor, such a joke about the Thirteenth Peak Master isn’t appropriate, that’s…

Lin Shoucheng hinted delicately.

With his status, he naturally had no place to correct a Planetary Governor.

But this matter could be big or small, and could even involve his own family, so Lin Shoucheng summoned the courage to speak.

“Hahahaha,”

Song Wuyang saw their reactions and showed no sign of surprise.

When he first learned that the Thirteenth Peak Master’s true identity was Lin Yuan, he was no less shocked.

“Mr. Lin, Mrs. Lu, and Miss Lin,”

“I, Song Wuyang, am quite lucid; your son is the Thirteenth Peak Master.”

“Soon, a guard unit from Chenxi Mainstar will come to protect you,” Song Wuyang said earnestly.

“Ah?”

Lu Qiong and Lin Shoucheng looked at each other in bewilderment.

It was at this moment that they faintly realized that Song Wuyang was not joking.

“Impossible.”

“My brother is just at Fourth Rank, while the Thirteenth Peak Master is at Sixth Rank.”

Lin Yi couldn’t help but say.

“That’s because the Thirteenth Peak Master’s talent and aptitude are too terrifying. If he revealed his true identity, those different species would surely keep attempting assassinations continuously,”

Song Wuyang said without hesitation.

He then directly shared the identity confirmation document from Chenxi Mainstar with them.

“This…”

Lu Qiong and Lin Shoucheng were flabbergasted.

After seeing the unique seal of Chenxi Mainstar on the document, they took a while to come to their senses.

“Then I’ll take my leave now.”

“If there is anything, you can contact me at any time.”

Seeing the situation, Song Wuyang immediately got up to leave.

He had come specifically to inform Lu Qiong and Lin Shoucheng of this matter.

In order to gain their favor.

Now that he had achieved his goal, and Lu Qiong and the Lin family probably had a lot to discuss, it wouldn’t be appropriate for him to remain.

…

On Chikun Main Star,

At the palace atop the Thirteenth Peak,

“Finally…”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a smile appearing on his face.

Ever since he arrived at Chikun Main Star, he hadn’t rested at all, constantly integrating his life force brand into the universe.

At last, he had completed it.

“Right, before stepping into Sixth Rank,”

the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had already been nearly perfected.

A thought suddenly struck Lin Yuan.

The perfected Martial Path Evolutionary Path was no longer limited to Taiyin Taiyang Taiji; it could include all sorts of world energy rules into the Martial Arts System and cultivate according to the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

“Let’s upload it.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

After advancing into Sixth Rank, he had always been busy. Only the changes in the Door to the Myriad Realms had distracted him for a while. Now, finally having some time, he was ready to upload the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

The perfected Martial Path Evolutionary Path significantly reduced the threshold for cultivation. Lin Yuan was somewhat eager to see what the three goddesses would think of it.
